# AntV X6 2.18.1

Unmodified browser distributions from the published `@antv/x6@2.18.1` package:

- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@antv/x6@2.18.1/dist/index.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@antv/x6@2.18.1/dist/index.css
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@antv/x6@2.18.1/LICENSE

Downloaded 2026-10-31. MIT license included alongside the assets. The UMD bundle exposes `window.X6`; it requires no application build or runtime package installation. These files are served locally. Sketch only uses the core graph engine; selection, undo, validation, and layout are application-owned.
